title: Sauerbraten with Chorizo and Casserole
description: A traditional German dish with a twist, featuring the spicy flavors of chorizo and a hearty casserole.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together vinegar, water, salt, and black pepper to make marinade.
Add sliced beef and let it marinate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
In a large skillet, heat oil over medium heat.
Add sliced chorizo and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add cubed bread to the skillet and cook until toasted, about 3-4 minutes.
In a large Dutch oven, create a layer of shredded red cabbage.
Add sliced beef on top of the cabbage, then spoon the chorizo-bread mixture over the beef.
Cover the Dutch oven with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 2 hours or until the meat is tender.
Serve warm, garnished with crushed casserole.
